headline: Thanksgiving Hunt
tagline: Turkey's resting. Let the hunt begin!

scenes.title: Find & Color for Toddlers
scenes.say: Little ones spot the real thing around the room, then color in the matching picture.

scenes.title: Friendsgiving Table Hunt
tips: Great for older kids and adults
scenes.say: Hand this out while everyone's seated, and race to spot the little details on the table.

scenes.title: Outdoor Fall Checklist
tips: Take it on an after-dinner walk
scenes.say: Take it outside after the meal and check off fall finds on a family walk.

scenes.title: Camera Roll Hunt
tips: Find a matching photo on your phone
scenes.say: Pass the page around and race to find a matching photo already on your phone.

scenes.title: Riddle Clue Cards
tips: Eight riddles to hide in order
Each clue leads to the next spot
scenes.say: Hide the eight riddles around the house, and each one leads kids to the next spot.

tips.title: Before you print
items: Most pages come in color and black and white
Print one sheet per player or team
tips.say: Most pages come in color and black and white, so print one for every player or team.

say.title: Free printable Thanksgiving scavenger hunts to keep everyone busy after the turkey.
say.hook: Print, hand them out, and let the hunt begin.
say.end: Download them all free at printamoo dot com.
